$comment: Which routes render the comment UI, as a glob pattern list over the locale-less route path. Enabling comments on a page is a one-line edit here. `apiBase` is the origin of the comments Worker; an empty string means same-origin (the Cloudflare Workers mirror). On the GitHub Pages canonical host there is no /api/comments, so the client probe fails and the component renders its honest unavailable state instead of a form that cannot work.
